exposure: Surgical method for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
outcome: Time of serum ß-hCG returning to normal
cohort: 173 patients with type II and III cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
finding: For type II and III CSP, hysteroscopy and laparoscopy with reversible ligation of the uterine artery led to better postoperative recovery outcomes compared to hysteroscopy or curettage alone.
